fields.description: When enabled, HR will see a "Statutory Forms" button group on the Employee Onboarding form to generate / regenerate the PF Form 11 and Gratuity Nomination PDFs.
fields.label: Enable Statutory Forms Button on Employee Onboarding

fields.description: When enabled, on saving an Employee Onboarding the Reporting Manager (Reports To) is auto-filled from the Branch Head of the candidate's Work Location, if it is empty. Manual values are always preserved.
fields.label: Auto-map Reporting Manager from Branch Head

fields.description: When enabled, changing the DOJ Outcome on an Employee Onboarding runs the automated flow: Joined creates/activates the Employee, Not Joined cancels the Job Offer and reopens the Requisition, Postponed reschedules the onboarding to the new date. When disabled, the DOJ Outcome field is just stored with no side effects.
fields.label: Automate DOJ Outcome (Joined / Not Joined / Postponed)

fields.description: When enabled, HR can Approve the onboarding form or Send Back rejected fields to the candidate — from the Employee Onboarding desk form AND the portal UI. These actions drive the Flow Config emails (Form Approved / Updates Needed). Leave OFF for projects that don't use this review flow. Per-site setting, so enable only on the one project's site.
fields.label: Enable Onboarding Review Actions (Approve / Send Back)

fields.description: Onboarding Status means 'the candidate's form is done', not 'the tasks are done'. It reads Completed the moment every candidate portal field is Approved; a field rejected afterwards takes it back to In Process, and re-approving returns it to Completed. Task progress no longer overwrites it. Leave OFF to keep the standard meaning, where the onboarding tasks drive the status.
fields.label: Complete Onboarding on Form Approval

fields.description: Heading shown above the onboarding journey on the candidate portal.
fields.label: Journey Heading

fields.description: Sub-heading shown under the journey heading (e.g. "Your first two weeks — at a glance.").
fields.label: Journey Sub-heading

fields.description: Define the post-joining journey steps once here; they surface on every candidate portal via get_candidate_portal_form.
fields.label: Onboarding Journey Steps
